title: Refund policy
text: Acme Cloud offers a refund within 14 days of purchase for monthly plans only. Annual plans are non-refundable. Contact billing@acme.example to request a refund; refunds are issued as account credit.

title: Plans and pricing
text: Acme Cloud has three plans. Starter costs $12 per user per month and includes 1 project. Pro costs $39 per user per month and includes 10 projects. Enterprise has custom pricing and adds SSO and audit logs.

title: Single sign-on (SSO)
text: SAML single sign-on is available on the Enterprise plan only. Contact your account manager to enable it. Okta is the only supported identity provider.

title: API rate limits
text: The Acme Cloud API allows 60 requests per minute on Starter and 300 requests per minute on Pro and Enterprise. Limits apply per API key.

title: Uptime and SLA
text: Acme Cloud targets 99.9% monthly uptime on all plans. There is no contractual SLA and no service credits.

title: Support hours and channels
text: Support is available by email Monday to Friday, 9:00 to 17:00 US Eastern time, for all plans. Response target is 2 business days.

title: Exporting your data
text: Workspace owners can export all projects as JSON or CSV from Settings > Data > Export. Exports are prepared in the background and a download link valid for 7 days is emailed when ready.

title: Deleting your account
text: To delete a workspace, email support@acme.example. Data is removed within 90 days.
